sections.what: Declares the browser-only part, the six allowed motif names, and the shape of a point.
sections.why: Fixes the set of drawings that exist.

sections.name: rng
sections.title: Repeatable random generator
sections.what: Creates a random number source from a seed.
sections.why: The same motif always looks the same.
sections.watch_out: Changing this logic changes every drawing.

sections.name: build (part 1)
sections.title: Building the plant and layers drawings
sections.what: Builds points and labels for the plant drawing (tanks, pipes, and agents) and the layers drawing (three stacked planes).
sections.why: Each drawing is made of points so no image files are needed.
sections.watch_out: Only the first three labels are drawn.

sections.name: build: for
sections.title: Building the radar, branches, and start of pitch drawings
sections.what: Finishes the layers drawing, then builds the radar sweep, the branching scenario tree, and the first part of the cricket ground.
sections.why: Each drawing is a visual metaphor for its curiosity.
sections.watch_out: The branch drawing repeats itself to grow deeper, so its depth limit controls how many points it makes.

sections.name: build: for
sections.title: Finishing pitch and building the die drawing
sections.what: Adds ball paths to the cricket ground, then builds a die made of cores with a bright centre labelled as one person.
sections.watch_out: The die uses a fixed grid, so its point count is high.

sections.name: CuriosityPlate (part 1)
sections.title: Animation loop and projection
sections.what: Each frame, turns the points into a tilted view, fades distant points, and draws them. Turning stops for users who prefer reduced motion.
sections.why: The turn and fog give depth. Reduced motion users get a still picture.
sections.watch_out: Drawing pauses when the plate is off screen to save work.

sections.name: CuriosityPlate (part 2)
sections.title: Labels, header band, and tick marks
sections.what: Draws the clipped point cloud below a header band, then the labels, the header with the code and point count, and tick marks along the bottom.
sections.why: The header band keeps labels from covering the title.
sections.watch_out: Labels are kept inside the drawing area, so nearby labels can overlap.

summary: Draws a slowly turning dot-cloud picture on a canvas for each curiosity, with small labels on top.
purpose: Gives every curiosity card a distinct visual without needing image files.
why: Each picture is built from points using a seeded random generator, so it is the same on every visit and needs no image downloads.
how: Builds a set of points for one of six named motifs, then each animation frame tilts and turns the points, fades distant ones, draws them, and adds labels and a header band.
inputs: A motif name from the six allowed names, a code such as C01, a title, and the reduced motion preference.
outputs: A canvas drawing with an accessible label containing the title.
risks: Redraws every frame while on screen, so many points can slow weaker devices. Adding a motif needs changes in more than one place.
debug: If the plate is blank, check that the motif name is one of the six allowed names. If it does not turn, check the reduced motion setting. If it draws when scrolled away, check the visibility observer.
